name: Comic Book
description: Bold inked contours with dynamic angles, flat saturated colours, Ben-Day halftone shading, spotted blacks and energetic action typography.
visual_characteristics: thick-to-thin ink outlines with confident spotted blacks
flat CMYK-like colour (primary red, yellow, cyan, magenta) with halftone dot shading
dynamic foreshortening, diagonal composition, speed lines and impact bursts
onomatopoeia and caption boxes as graphic elements

palette.guidance: Primary-leaning process colours: red #e63946, yellow #ffd60a, cyan #00b4d8, magenta #d81b60, plus ink black and paper cream. Shadows via halftone dots or darker flat tone, not gradients.

geometry: Heroic proportions, angular shadows, dramatic perspective and cropping; bursts as jagged star polygons; panel borders as skewed rectangles with gutters.
stroke: Variable line weight: heavy outer contour (4-6 units), medium interior (2-3), fine detail (1). Round joins on outer contour, miter on bursts; filled-black shadow shapes.
texture: Ben-Day dots via <pattern> (circles on a rotated 45 degree grid, size varies by tone) used for skin tones and shadows; zip-a-tone diagonal hatching.
composition: Dynamic Dutch angles, subject breaking the panel frame, speed lines converging on the focal point, high contrast between black masses and bright colour.
typography: Bold hand-lettered caps: impact SFX text with thick outline and drop shadow (e.g. 'POW!'), caption boxes in yellow with black border.
lighting_depth: Hard light: solid black cast shadows and rim highlights; depth via overlap and line weight (thick foreground, thin background).
svg_techniques: halftone: <pattern patternTransform="rotate(45)"> with a dot circle; vary dot radius by defining 3 patterns (light/mid/dark) and using them on clipped shape regions
ink layer separate from colour layer (colour slightly offset for print mis-registration)
burst = star <polygon> with alternating radii, thick outline, drop shadow polygon offset
text with paint-order="stroke" for outlined lettering

name: Manga
description: Crisp black-ink linework with G-pen line variation, screentone shading, expressive emotive framing, speed lines and emphasis effects; mostly black and white with optional single-colour accents.
visual_characteristics: clean, precise contours with tapered strokes; hair as flowing clumps with highlight gaps
large expressive eyes / stylised faces; emotion effects (sweat drops, blush lines, sparkles)
speed lines, focus lines and dramatic panel framing

palette.guidance: Ink black on white paper, with 2-3 screentone greys (dot patterns at different densities). Optional colour-page variant: flat cel colours with soft cool shadow tone.

geometry: Slender proportions, angular jaw/hair points, dynamic gesture; background rendered with ruler-straight perspective lines; effects lines radiate from a focal point.
stroke: Tapered variable-width filled paths for contours (thick at shadow side, thin at highlights); hairline for hatch; round caps; 3 weights (outer 3, inner 1.5, detail .7).
texture: Screentones: <pattern> of dots at 45 degrees (three densities), gradient tones via dot radius ramp; hatch and cross-hatch; solid black fill for deep shadows.
composition: Panel-based or splash page; emphasis by empty white margins; radial focus lines behind the subject; asymmetric framing with strong diagonal.
typography: Vertical-feel SFX strokes as shapes, speech balloons with tails; keep text minimal or as shapes.
lighting_depth: Graphic: black cast shadows plus tone; rim-light gaps in hair; atmospheric perspective by thinner distant lines.
svg_techniques: tapered contour = closed path built from two offset curves (or stroke + separate thinner overlay)
3 screentone <pattern> defs (dot radius .6/1.1/1.6 at spacing 4, patternTransform rotate 45)
speed lines = many <line> in a radial <g> with clip to panel; vary length and weight
panel frame as thick rect stroke with skewed variants
